title: Modernization execution contract (machine form)
groundedBy: .github/scripts/shared/verify-step-artifacts.ps1 :: New-ControlPlaneSkeleton (deterministic No-QA writer; authoritative minimum shape)
authoringNote: Two legitimate producers write this file: the deterministic No-QA skeleton (New-ControlPlaneSkeleton, which always writes reportId + title) and the Step 5 agent (enriched, derived from real inventory). This contract MUST pass on the skeleton, so the required floor is intentionally identity-only. Operational fields (workspace roots, ports, orderedSlices) are NOT required or type-checked here because their enriched shape is owned by Step 5 and may legitimately vary, and every real consumer is presence-based or defensive (Step 7 reads this as an advisory input with a deterministic fallback). Step 5's prompt mandates these same identity fields so the producer and this contract stay aligned. Tighten operational fields later only after the enriched shape is pinned in the prompt.
